nodes.label: Rescue Ending Key Art (rescue.jpg)
nodes.rationale: Sepia engraving-style illustration used on the rescue/ending newspaper screen; warm dawn light and open doors signal resolution and release after the noir investigation.

nodes.label: Harbour at Dawn Setting
nodes.rationale: Waterfront promenade with domed civic building, gas lamp, vintage car, steamship, crane, bollard and seagull under a rising sun; dawn contrasts with the game's night-time noir palette.

nodes.label: Detective and Rescued Woman Walking Out
nodes.rationale: A man in a herringbone trench coat (the detective) walks beside a woman in a 1940s suit carrying a book or ledger, both leaving through open doors toward the harbour - depicts the rescued victim/witness freed alive.

nodes.label: Hospital / Clinic Doorway (Red Cross Emblem)
nodes.rationale: The cross emblem on the wall marks the building being exited as a hospital or clinic - the site of the organ-trafficking operation - so walking out symbolises escape from it.

nodes.label: 1940s Sepia Engraving Style
nodes.rationale: Cross-hatched, sepia-toned period illustration matching a vintage newspaper print aesthetic for the ending screen.
